title: LECTOR: LLM-Enhanced Concept-based Test-Oriented Repetition

contributions.purpose: 在间隔重复调度中显式建模概念间语义干扰
contributions.mechanism: 用 LLM(DeepSeek-V3)的 In-Context Learning 评估概念对混淆风险,构建语义干扰矩阵 S,并入改进的遗忘曲线调整复习间隔
contributions.evaluation: 100 名模拟学习者/100 天:LECTOR 成功率 90.2%,高于 SSP-MMC 88.4%(相对 +2.0%/绝对 +1.8pp)
contributions.domain: 教育技术/间隔重复/智能辅导
contributions.source_quote: Semantic-Aware Scheduling: Integration of LLM-powered semantic analysis to identify and mitigate confusion between similar concepts, particularly crucial for test environments with semantic distractors.

contributions.purpose: 按个体学习特征动态个性化调度
contributions.mechanism: 为每个学习者维护 4 维 profile(成功率/学习速度/记忆保持/语义敏感度),用指数移动平均随反馈演化
contributions.evaluation: 模拟中支撑 90.2% 成功率;定量消融未单列该组件贡献
contributions.source_quote: Personalized Learning Profiles: Dynamic adaptation based on individual learning patterns and test preparation needs.

contributions.purpose: 多因子综合优化间隔、以成功率优先
contributions.mechanism: 间隔计算综合难度/掌握度/重复历史/语义关系四类调整因子(I*=I_base·∏F_k),偏向成功率而非效率
contributions.evaluation: 换取更高成功率的代价:效率分 3.73(SSP-MMC 4.42,-15.7%)、学习负担 50,706 次尝试(次高)
contributions.source_quote: Multi-Dimensional Optimization: Comprehensive consideration of difficulty, mastery, repetition history, and semantic relationships with emphasis on success rate over efficiency.

self_declared_provenance.quote: The core algorithm extends the classical forgetting curve to incorporate semantic interference effects.

notes: reject。结果基于 100 名模拟学习者/100 天(非真实用户),Paper Checklist 自承无 error bar/置信区间(Q7=No)、提交时未开源代码/数据(Q5=No)。收益边际且表述有偏:全文反复把 SSP-MMC(88.4%)称作 'best baseline' 并宣称 +1.8pp,但 Table 1 显示 FSRS 才是最强基线(89.6%)——与真正最近基线的真实差距仅 0.6pp。trade-off(带数字):以成功率换效率——效率分 3.73<SSP-MMC 4.42(-15.7%)、总尝试 50,706 次为次高学习负担;并对外部 LLM 服务有依赖性(可靠性/成本风险,作者自列 Limitation)。AI 自我披露:AI Involvement Checklist 中实验设计/数据分析/写作均为 D(AI 完成,人类仅审查),hypothesis 为 C;Observed AI Limitations 自承 LLM 处理长文本存在 topic drift、多次重试比复杂 prompt engineering 更有效。self-declared provenance:extends classical forgetting curve,并构建于 SSP-MMC/FSRS 之上。贡献按论文声明的 3 项 key innovations 抽取。
